name: ai.khwan/khwan-mcp
title: Khwan
description: Durable AI memory: recall distilled facts in a later session or subagent, and remember new ones.

environmentVariables.name: KHWAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Khwan key from https://app.khwan.ai (kwk_live_...). It authenticates you to Khwan; it is not your model provider's key.

environmentVariables.name: KHWAN_CORE
environmentVariables.description: Select a named core (brain). Paid plans only — the free plan has just `default`, and an unknown slug answers 404. Leave unset to use the default.

environmentVariables.name: KHWAN_USER
environmentVariables.description: A separate brain inside the core, created on first write — 3 on the free plan, unlimited on paid. Sets the X-Khwan-User header.

environmentVariables.name: KHWAN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8010 for a self-hosted engine.
